mechanism: Response cost / social-exposure cost of accepting the message
interpretation_note: Recurs in every domain but has never been directly operationalised or manipulated as a construct. Breadth is high; direct evidence is absent. Treat as the corpus's leading testable hypothesis, not a finding.

Best behavioural evidence is the Change.org petition dataset (agency language predicts signatures, outrage does not). Health evidence is bundled (FFIT, BCT review). Preference evidence is qualitative.

Overwhelmingly the manosphere literature's strongest descriptive finding (explanatory compression, red-pill certainty). Health-side evidence is practice-level (ALEC, Talk Club scale). No controlled test.

Only mechanism supported in all seven domains. Strongest single evidence: FFIT RCT + sports realist review + dissertation finding that Community is the top determinant in 78.6% of 154 studies and 100% of Indonesian studies.
Former-incel interviews and Ofcom are the strongest sources; all qualitative. The key analytic move is separating validation of DIFFICULTY from validation of an EXPLANATION.

Two independent meta-analyses (reactance; moral appeals) plus the Real Men brochure trial. This is the single best-evidenced wording-level mechanism in the entire corpus - and it is a GENERAL human mechanism.

mechanism: Identity congruence vs unnecessary identity negotiation
interpretation_note: The masculinity-framing domain is the only one that tests it properly. Central finding: gender labelling helps where a gender problem already exists and adds friction where it does not.
Provider identity is the single most consistently coded masculinity norm in the dissertation corpus (30% overall, 34% Global South) and is legally and religiously codified in Indonesia.

Second mechanism present in all seven domains. Indonesian sociolinguistics gives it unusual specificity: register is relationally licensed, so the same words carry opposite meanings from different speakers.
Best evidence is the CSA meta-analysis and the woke-washing experiments. Directly transferable to a nonprofit: concrete internal action beats abstract positioning.
Essentially a single-domain finding, but it is the domain closest to the applied question and it directly challenges the individual-help-seeker assumption every other domain silently imports.
Gotong royong, rukun and classificatory kinship widen the circle of care and the circle of judgement by the same mechanism. Has no analogue in the Global North literature.

mechanism: Meaning-making / religious frame (fatalism vs active coping)
interpretation_note: Religion coded in 34% of Global South vs 5% of Global North studies - the single largest North/South divergence in the dissertation's 154-study corpus. Same faith produces takdir fatalism or ngelakoni active management.

mechanism: Material and institutional friction (cost, queues, gatekeeping)
interpretation_note: SES is the second most-coded determinant across 154 studies (70.1%) and appears in five of six Indonesian studies. This mechanism operates BEFORE any wording and can nullify communication entirely.

Highest usage, weakest isolation. Man Therapy RCT is the closest thing to a test and it was null on clinical outcomes. Humour is simultaneously the manosphere's best-documented entry hook and an unproven persuasion technique.
Looksmaxxing shows the same mechanism producing both actionability and self-objectification/demoralisation. Talk Club's 'out of 10' is the benign version.
Two independent causal demonstrations (TikTok audit; virality-increases-outrage experiments). Constrains what any organisation can measure: engagement is partly endogenous.

evidence_strength: MODERATE for non-linearity; VERY WEAK for any numeric optimum
interpretation_note: Single-domain but methodologically strong. The 0.30 density figure is corpus-specific and must never be used as a copywriting rule.
The manosphere's most underappreciated internal split (improvement vs blackpill) maps directly onto a design choice for any men's mental-health organisation: explain without foreclosing.

Resolves the apparent directness contradiction. Sharp et al. found the SAME men preferring coded emotional language and direct action language. The dissertation's 'nongkrong yuk' reading is the Indonesian version.
